note.ja-JP:
【目的】ミニゲーム。人数が少ない分、ボールも判断も速く来て、誰もプレーから隠れられない。
【頻度】ほぼ毎日の締め。ミニゲームで、練習したすべてがプレッシャー下に出る。
【準備】2対2、赤：A・B、ボールは1番。
【ボールの道筋】1 → A → 1
【流れ】ステップ1：1番がAへ打つ。ステップ2：Aが1番へ打つ、1番・Aが後方へ移動、2番が右へ移動、Bが左へ移動。
【続け方】1ポイントずつ最後まで打って得点を数え、2ポイントごとにサーブ交代。11点で1ゲーム、コート・パートナー・相手を替える。
【ルール】ライン内に落ちれば得点、アウト・ネット・ツーバウンドは失点。2点ごとにサーブ交代、ライン上はイン。
【ポイント】サーブは必ず右半面から右半面へ、そして一球ごとに交互に打つ。だからローテーションこそが練習だ。打つ動作のまま相手の進路を空ける。

จุดเน้น: เสิร์ฟจากครึ่งขวาไปครึ่งขวาเสมอ และต้องสลับตีทุกลูก
note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Trò chơi sân nhỏ: ít người hơn nên bóng và mọi quyết định đến nhanh hơn, không ai trốn khỏi trận đấu được.
Tần suất: Kết thúc buổi tập gần như mỗi ngày — trò chơi sân nhỏ là nơi mọi thứ đã tập được thể hiện dưới áp lực.
Bố trí: 2 đấu 2, đội đỏ: A, B, bóng ở chỗ 1.
Đường bóng: 1 → A → 1
Trình tự: Bước 1: 1 đánh sang A; Bước 2: A đánh sang 1, 1, A di chuyển lùi lại, 2 di chuyển sang phải, B di chuyển sang trái.
Tiếp nối: Đánh hết từng điểm và tính điểm; đổi giao bóng sau mỗi hai điểm. Ván đến 11, rồi đổi sân, đổi cặp hoặc đổi đối thủ.
Luật: Bóng rơi trong vạch thì thắng điểm; ra ngoài, chạm lưới hoặc nảy hai lần là mất điểm. Đổi giao bóng sau mỗi hai điểm, bóng chạm vạch là trong sân.
Điểm chính: Giao bóng luôn từ nửa phải sang nửa phải, và phải luân phiên mỗi quả.

note.en:
Purpose: Fitness without the ball: accelerate, change direction, and do it again tired — the movement the sport asks for, when the match is decided by who can still produce it.
Frequency: Loaded into fitness days and the pre-season, when the base for the whole year is built.
Setup: three cones on the floor behind the table — the two corners and the middle; the player starts in the middle in his playing stance.
Equipment: the cones are the two corners of the table and the middle: side-step to a corner, play the stroke, side-step back — the feet stay behind the cones, never under the table.
Sequence: Step 1: the player moves left to side-shuffle without crossing the feet; Step 2: the player moves right to side-shuffle without crossing the feet; Step 3: the player moves right to side-shuffle without crossing the feet; Step 4: the player moves left to side-shuffle without crossing the feet.
How it continues: Thirty seconds of side-stepping with the full stroke, thirty seconds' rest; twelve repetitions. Count the strokes and try to beat the count next time.
Coaching point: Play the stroke at every corner — a footwork drill in which nobody swings is a running drill, and the racket arm is half of the balance.

note.zh-CN:
【目的】无球体能：加速、变向、疲劳下还能重复——这项运动要求的移动能力，比赛往往由谁还做得出来决定。
【频度】安排在体能日和赛季初——为一整年打底子的时候。
【组织】球台后方地面放三个锥标：两个角和中间；球员在中间以击球站位站好。
【器材】锥标代表球台的两个角和中间：并步移到一个角做出击球动作再移回来——脚始终在锥标后面，不要钻到台下。
【流程】第1步：球员向左移动（侧滑步，脚不交叉）；第2步：球员向右移动（侧滑步，脚不交叉）；第3步：球员向右移动（侧滑步，脚不交叉）；第4步：球员向左移动（侧滑步，脚不交叉）。
【连贯】带完整挥拍的并步移动 30 秒、休息 30 秒，做 12 次。数一数挥了多少拍，下次争取更多。
【要点】每到一个点都要把挥拍动作做出来——不挥拍的步法练习只是跑步，而持拍手是平衡的一半。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】無球體能：加速、變向、疲勞下還能重複——這項運動要求的移動能力，比賽往往由誰還做得出來決定。
【頻度】安排在體能日和賽季初——為一整年打底子的時候。
【組織】球台後方地面放三個錐標：兩個角和中間；球員在中間以擊球站位站好。
【器材】錐標代表球檯的兩個角和中間：併步移到一個角做出擊球動作再移回來——腳始終在錐標後面，不要鑽到檯下。
【流程】第1步：球員向左移動（側滑步，腳不交叉）；第2步：球員向右移動（側滑步，腳不交叉）；第3步：球員向右移動（側滑步，腳不交叉）；第4步：球員向左移動（側滑步，腳不交叉）。
【連貫】帶完整揮拍的併步移動 30 秒、休息 30 秒，做 12 次。數一數揮了多少拍，下次爭取更多。
【要點】每到一個點都要把揮拍動作做出來——不揮拍的步法練習只是跑步，而持拍手是平衡的一半。
note.ja-JP:
【目的】ボールなしのフィジカル：加速、方向転換、疲れてももう一度——競技が求める動きで、勝負はまだそれができる側が決める。
【頻度】フィットネス日とプレシーズンに組み込む。一年の土台を作る時期。
【準備】three cones on the floor behind the table — the two corners and the middle; the player starts in the middle in his playing stance。
【用具】the cones are the two corners of the table and the middle: side-step to a corner, play the stroke, side-step back — the feet stay behind the cones, never under the table。
【流れ】ステップ1：選手が左へ移動し、足を交差させずサイドステップ。ステップ2：選手が右へ移動し、足を交差させずサイドステップ。ステップ3：選手が右へ移動し、足を交差させずサイドステップ。ステップ4：選手が左へ移動し、足を交差させずサイドステップ。
【続け方】Thirty seconds of side-stepping with the full stroke, thirty seconds' rest; twelve repetitions. Count the strokes and try to beat the count next time.
【ポイント】各コーナーで必ずスイングする——振らないフットワークはただの走りで、ラケット側の腕はバランスの半分だ。
note.ko-KR:
【목적】볼 없는 체력: 가속, 방향 전환, 지쳐도 한 번 더 — 종목이 요구하는 움직임이며, 승부는 아직 그것을 해내는 쪽이 정한다.
【빈도】체력 훈련일과 프리시즌에 배치 — 한 해 전체의 기초를 쌓는 시기.
【준비】three cones on the floor behind the table — the two corners and the middle; the player starts in the middle in his playing stance.
【장비】the cones are the two corners of the table and the middle: side-step to a corner, play the stroke, side-step back — the feet stay behind the cones, never under the table.
【진행】1단계: 선수는 왼쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝; 2단계: 선수는 오른쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝; 3단계: 선수는 오른쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝; 4단계: 선수는 왼쪽으로 이동해 발을 교차하지 않고 사이드 스텝.
【이어가기】Thirty seconds of side-stepping with the full stroke, thirty seconds' rest; twelve repetitions. Count the strokes and try to beat the count next time.
【포인트】각 코너마다 스윙을 한다 — 스윙 없는 풋워크는 그냥 달리기이고, 라켓 든 팔이 균형의 절반이다.
note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Físico sin balón: acelerar, cambiar de dirección y repetirlo cansado; el movimiento que pide el deporte, y el partido lo decide quien todavía puede producirlo.
Frecuencia: Se programa en los días de físico y la pretemporada, cuando se construye la base del año.
Montaje: three cones on the floor behind the table — the two corners and the middle; the player starts in the middle in his playing stance.
Material: the cones are the two corners of the table and the middle: side-step to a corner, play the stroke, side-step back — the feet stay behind the cones, never under the table.
Secuencia: Paso 1: el jugador se desplaza a la izquierda para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies; Paso 2: el jugador se desplaza a la derecha para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies; Paso 3: el jugador se desplaza a la derecha para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies; Paso 4: el jugador se desplaza a la izquierda para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies.
Continuidad: Thirty seconds of side-stepping with the full stroke, thirty seconds' rest; twelve repetitions. Count the strokes and try to beat the count next time.
Punto clave: Golpea en cada esquina: un ejercicio de pies en el que nadie golpea es correr, y el brazo de la raqueta es la mitad del equilibrio.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Physique sans ballon : accélérer, changer de direction et recommencer fatigué — le mouvement qu'exige le sport, et le match revient à qui peut encore le produire.
Fréquence : Placé lors des journées physiques et de la présaison, quand se construit la base de l'année.
Mise en place : three cones on the floor behind the table — the two corners and the middle; the player starts in the middle in his playing stance.
Matériel : the cones are the two corners of the table and the middle: side-step to a corner, play the stroke, side-step back — the feet stay behind the cones, never under the table.
Déroulé : Étape 1 : le joueur se déplace à gauche pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds ; Étape 2 : le joueur se déplace à droite pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds ; Étape 3 : le joueur se déplace à droite pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds ; Étape 4 : le joueur se déplace à gauche pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds.
Enchaînement : Thirty seconds of side-stepping with the full stroke, thirty seconds' rest; twelve repetitions. Count the strokes and try to beat the count next time.
Point clé : Joue le coup à chaque coin — un travail de jambes sans frappe n'est que de la course, et le bras de la raquette fait la moitié de l'équilibre.

note.en:
Purpose: Fitness without the ball: accelerate, change direction, and do it again tired — the movement the sport asks for, when the match is decided by who can still produce it.
Frequency: Loaded into fitness days and the pre-season, when the base for the whole year is built.
Setup: two cones close to the end of the table and two a step and a half behind them; the player starts between the pairs.
Equipment: the near pair is the short-ball position at the table, the far pair the deep position: step in between the near cones for the short ball, out behind the far cones for the deep one.
Sequence: Step 1: the player moves up the board to decelerate and stop under control; Step 2: the player moves back to backpedal, eyes up; Step 3: the player moves back to backpedal, eyes up; Step 4: the player gets back to the cone.
How it continues: Twenty seconds in and out with the stroke at each end, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, and the last three with the coach calling short or long at random.
Coaching point: In with a small step, out with two — the mistake is going in with a big step, because then there is no way back for the next ball.

【器材】近端一对是台内处理短球的位置，远端一对是退台击球的位置：处理短球进到近端锥标之间，打长球退到远端锥标之后。
【流程】第1步：球员向前移动（减速并稳稳停住）；第2步：球员向后移动（后退跑，眼睛看前方）；第3步：球员向后移动（后退跑，眼睛看前方）；第4步：球员回到原位。
【连贯】进台退台做 20 秒，两端都要挥拍，休息 40 秒，做 10 次；最后 3 次由教练随机喊短球或长球。
【要点】进台用小步，退台用两步——错误是进台迈一大步，那样下一板就退不出来了。
note.zh-TW:
【目的】無球體能：加速、變向、疲勞下還能重複——這項運動要求的移動能力，比賽往往由誰還做得出來決定。
【頻度】安排在體能日和賽季初——為一整年打底子的時候。
【組織】球檯端線附近兩個錐標，其後一步半再放兩個錐標；球員站在兩對錐標之間。
【器材】近端一對是檯內處理短球的位置，遠端一對是退檯擊球的位置：處理短球進到近端錐標之間，打長球退到遠端錐標之後。
【流程】第1步：球員向前移動（減速並穩穩停住）；第2步：球員向後移動（後退跑，眼睛看前方）；第3步：球員向後移動（後退跑，眼睛看前方）；第4步：球員回到原位。
【連貫】進檯退檯做 20 秒，兩端都要揮拍，休息 40 秒，做 10 次；最後 3 次由教練隨機喊短球或長球。
【要點】進檯用小步，退檯用兩步——錯誤是進檯邁一大步，那樣下一板就退不出來了。

【頻度】フィットネス日とプレシーズンに組み込む。一年の土台を作る時期。

note.ko-KR:

note.es-ES:
Objetivo: Físico sin balón: acelerar, cambiar de dirección y repetirlo cansado; el movimiento que pide el deporte, y el partido lo decide quien todavía puede producirlo.
Frecuencia: Se programa en los días de físico y la pretemporada, cuando se construye la base del año.
Montaje: two cones close to the end of the table and two a step and a half behind them; the player starts between the pairs.
Material: the near pair is the short-ball position at the table, the far pair the deep position: step in between the near cones for the short ball, out behind the far cones for the deep one.
Secuencia: Paso 1: el jugador se desplaza hacia delante para frenar y parar con control; Paso 2: el jugador se desplaza hacia atrás para correr hacia atrás con la vista al frente; Paso 3: el jugador se desplaza hacia atrás para correr hacia atrás con la vista al frente; Paso 4: el jugador vuelve a su cono.
Continuidad: Twenty seconds in and out with the stroke at each end, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, and the last three with the coach calling short or long at random.

Objectif : Physique sans ballon : accélérer, changer de direction et recommencer fatigué — le mouvement qu'exige le sport, et le match revient à qui peut encore le produire.
Fréquence : Placé lors des journées physiques et de la présaison, quand se construit la base de l'année.
Mise en place : two cones close to the end of the table and two a step and a half behind them; the player starts between the pairs.
Matériel : the near pair is the short-ball position at the table, the far pair the deep position: step in between the near cones for the short ball, out behind the far cones for the deep one.
Déroulé : Étape 1 : le joueur se déplace vers l'avant pour décélérer et s'arrêter en contrôle ; Étape 2 : le joueur se déplace vers l'arrière pour courir en arrière, regard devant ; Étape 3 : le joueur se déplace vers l'arrière pour courir en arrière, regard devant ; Étape 4 : le joueur revient sur son plot.
Enchaînement : Twenty seconds in and out with the stroke at each end, forty seconds' rest; ten repetitions, and the last three with the coach calling short or long at random.
Point clé : Entrer d'un petit pas, sortir en deux : l'erreur est d'entrer d'une grande enjambée, car il n'y a plus de retour pour la balle suivante.

mistake.en-GB: Pacing the hard reps to survive the set — a rep held back is a rep that did not count.

note.en:
Purpose: Fitness without the ball: accelerate, change direction, and do it again tired — the movement the sport asks for, when the match is decided by who can still produce it.
Frequency: Loaded into fitness days and the pre-season, when the base for the whole year is built.
Setup: three cones behind the table in a triangle — two wide and forward, one back in the middle; the player starts between them.
Equipment: the two forward cones are the forehand and backhand corners at the table and the back cone is the deep recovery position; the path round them is a figure of eight.
Sequence: Step 1: the player moves left to sprint flat out; Step 2: the player moves right to side-shuffle without crossing the feet; Step 3: the player moves right to sprint flat out; Step 4: the player moves left to side-shuffle without crossing the feet.
How it continues: Twenty-five seconds of figure-eights, thirty-five seconds' rest; ten repetitions, and the feet do not stop moving inside a repetition.
Coaching point: The set is judged on the last rep, not the first: if the sixth is much slower than the second, the rest is too short or the effort was not honest.

【连贯】八字移动 25 秒、休息 35 秒，做 10 次；一次之内脚不许停下来。

Montaje: three cones behind the table in a triangle — two wide and forward, one back in the middle; the player starts between them.
Material: the two forward cones are the forehand and backhand corners at the table and the back cone is the deep recovery position; the path round them is a figure of eight.
Secuencia: Paso 1: el jugador se desplaza a la izquierda para esprintar a tope; Paso 2: el jugador se desplaza a la derecha para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies; Paso 3: el jugador se desplaza a la derecha para esprintar a tope; Paso 4: el jugador se desplaza a la izquierda para desplazarse lateral sin cruzar los pies.
Continuidad: Twenty-five seconds of figure-eights, thirty-five seconds' rest; ten repetitions, and the feet do not stop moving inside a repetition.
Punto clave: La serie se juzga por la última repetición, no por la primera: si la sexta es mucho más lenta que la segunda, el descanso es corto o el esfuerzo no fue honesto.
note.fr-FR:
Objectif : Physique sans ballon : accélérer, changer de direction et recommencer fatigué — le mouvement qu'exige le sport, et le match revient à qui peut encore le produire.
Fréquence : Placé lors des journées physiques et de la présaison, quand se construit la base de l'année.
Mise en place : three cones behind the table in a triangle — two wide and forward, one back in the middle; the player starts between them.
Matériel : the two forward cones are the forehand and backhand corners at the table and the back cone is the deep recovery position; the path round them is a figure of eight.
Déroulé : Étape 1 : le joueur se déplace à gauche pour sprinter à fond ; Étape 2 : le joueur se déplace à droite pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds ; Étape 3 : le joueur se déplace à droite pour sprinter à fond ; Étape 4 : le joueur se déplace à gauche pour pas chassés sans croiser les pieds.
Enchaînement : Twenty-five seconds of figure-eights, thirty-five seconds' rest; ten repetitions, and the feet do not stop moving inside a repetition.
Point clé : La série se juge à la dernière répétition, pas à la première : si la sixième est bien plus lente que la deuxième, la récupération est trop courte ou l'effort n'était pas sincère.

note.vi-VN:
Mục đích: Thể lực không bóng: tăng tốc, đổi hướng và lặp lại khi mệt — chuyển động môn này đòi hỏi, và trận đấu thuộc về bên còn làm được.
Tần suất: Xếp vào ngày thể lực và tiền mùa giải, khi xây nền cho cả năm.
Bố trí: three cones behind the table in a triangle — two wide and forward, one back in the middle; the player starts between them.
Dụng cụ: the two forward cones are the forehand and backhand corners at the table and the back cone is the deep recovery position; the path round them is a figure of eight.
Trình tự: Bước 1: cầu thủ di chuyển sang trái để chạy nước rút hết sức; Bước 2: cầu thủ di chuyển sang phải để trượt ngang không bắt chéo chân; Bước 3: cầu thủ di chuyển sang phải để chạy nước rút hết sức; Bước 4: cầu thủ di chuyển sang trái để trượt ngang không bắt chéo chân.
